from pathlib import Path
import os,tempfile,subprocess,json,hashlib,time
root=Path.cwd()
freeze=json.loads((root/'state/analysis/P7_app_motor_observe_raw/regression_freeze01.json').read_text())['pins']
checks=[]
hal=('recorder_frames','recorder','recorder_csv','recorder_dump','motors','imu','imu_acquisition','imu_acquisition_async','imu_heading','imu_adapter','line_qtr_adapter','ui','power_inputs','ui_display','qtr_cal','qtr_cal_format')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='sumox-d192-locked-',dir='/dev/shm') as temporary:
 scratch=Path(temporary); env=dict(os.environ,TMPDIR=temporary,ASAN_OPTIONS='detect_leaks=1:halt_on_error=1',UBSAN_OPTIONS='halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1')
 for active in (0,1):
  cases=['test_motor_gate.cpp','test_motor_halt.cpp']
  if not active:cases+=['test_countdown.cpp','test_robot_safety.cpp','test_edge_guard.cpp']
  sources=[root/'host/motor_gate_main.cpp',*[root/'tests/locked'/n for n in cases],*sorted((root/'src/core').glob('*.cpp')),*sorted((root/'src/app').glob('*.cpp')),*[root/'src/hal'/(n+'.cpp') for n in hal]]
  for sanitizer in (False,True):
   binary=scratch/'locked';flags=['-fsanitize=address,undefined','-fno-omit-frame-pointer','-no-pie'] if sanitizer else []
   argv=['g++','-std=c++17','-O1','-g1','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','-fno-exceptions','-fno-rtti','-DDOCTEST_CONFIG_NO_EXCEPTIONS_BUT_WITH_ALL_ASSERTS','-DMATCH=0',f'-DMOTORS_ALLOWED={active}','-ffunction-sections','-fdata-sections','-I'+str(root/'src'),'-I'+str(root/'host/third_party'),*flags,*map(str,sources),'-Wl,--gc-sections','-o',str(binary)]
   start=time.monotonic();build=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=180)
   result=dict(active=active,sanitized=sanitizer,compile_argv=argv,build_returncode=build.returncode,build_stdout=build.stdout,build_stderr=build.stderr)
   if build.returncode==0:
    fd=os.memfd_create('d192-locked',flags=0)
    try:
     with os.fdopen(os.dup(fd),'wb') as f:f.write(binary.read_bytes())
     r=subprocess.run([f'/proc/self/fd/{fd}'],capture_output=True,text=True,pass_fds=(fd,),env=env,timeout=60)
     result.update(returncode=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout,stderr=r.stderr)
    finally:os.close(fd);binary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
   result['elapsed_s']=time.monotonic()-start;checks.append(result);print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
   if build.returncode or result.get('returncode')!=0:raise SystemExit(1)
assert all(hashlib.sha256((root/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for n,h in freeze.items())
print('PINS_UNCHANGED')
